# Evidence
- Problem class: go-sqlite-row-map-time-parse-layout-mismatch-swallowed-error
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-10-21T18:32:51.856Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: API serializes timestamps as zero-time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) and nulls while DB rows carry correct values. Root cause: the row mapper does `if v, ok := row["created_at"].(string); ok { req.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v) }` — two failure shapes: (1) the write path hands Go time.Time values to the driver so the stored string layout is NOT RFC3339 (e.g. "2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999 -0700 MST" style), every Parse fails and the swallowed `_` error leaves the zero time; (2) on Postgres the driver returns time.Time, so the .(string) assertion fails and the field is never set. Fix: normalize writes to RFC3339Nano UTC AND parse defensively across layouts plus driver time.Time; never swallow parse errors (log/propagate). Cover list, detail and scoped-list surfaces; RED test first asserting round-trip against the DB values. Verified fix: consensus 6487bf6b (DF-CONSENSUS-61), 4 subtests reproduced zero-time pre-fix.
signatures.environment: Go + sqlite (modernc/mattn drivers) with optional Postgres; row maps scanned into structs
